entities.name: Dutch Settlement and Colonial Foundations
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Dutch West India Company established the first permanent European settlements along the Essequibo (1616), Berbice (1627), and Demerara rivers. Dutch colonists developed sugar and cotton plantations using enslaved African labour, laying the economic and social foundations of colonial Guyana.
